organization.name: Inno Craft Limited / Matomo
organization.notes: 2007 is Piwik/Matomo project origin; renamed Matomo in 2018. December 2016 company announcement identifies newly founded Inno Craft as business steward, separate from Piwik PRO. Current privacy policy names Inno Craft Limited. Exact company formation date, external equity investors and financing unresolved; project age is not company age.

pricingTiers.name: Community
pricingTiers.notes: Unlimited users/hits; premium plugin bundles and infrastructure separate.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Popular badge. Displayed monthly card €1450; up to 20 users/30 Mhits per month. Annual toggle discounted comparison differs; annual total not verified.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Named Business bundle; premium features exceed Community scope. Monthly displayed card; annual contract total left unresolved.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Displayed monthly card €3400 up to 50 users/100 Mhits monthly; separate VIP custom offer exists. Annual total unverified.

moats.claim: Long-lived analytics schema, integration/plugin ecosystem and historical report data create migration friction.

productReasons.claim: Unsampled reporting and visitor segmentation preserve detailed traffic investigation.
Campaign, ecommerce, internal-search and event reports cover marketing behavior in one analytics interface.
Tag Manager and tracking/reporting APIs support custom instrumentation and reporting workflows.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: Matomo 5 stable requirements used; Matomo 6.0 beta PHP 8.1 requirements deliberately excluded.

requirements.component: Apache, nginx, IIS or Lite Speed webserver
PHP CLI and scheduled report archiving
requirements.notes: CLI recommended; PHP extensions curl/gd/xml/mbstring enhance reports and integrations.
No mandatory external cache/queue identified in basic stable requirements.

resources.storage: 50 GB SSD recommended for <=100, 000 monthly pageviews
resources.os: Linux, Windows, mac OS Server or Free BSD
resources.notes: Workload-specific recommended configuration, not absolute minimum; larger traffic tables require larger/multiple servers.

selfHosting.notes: Stable Matomo 5 stack distinguished from documented Matomo 6 beta. PHP application can use standard webserver or Word Press plugin route; My SQL/Maria DB, not Postgre SQL. No mandatory Redis requirement identified.

options.name: Matomo Analytics Word Press plugin
options.notes: Official matomoteam plugin installs analytics inside an existing Word Press installation in a few clicks; not a blank-server deployment.

oneClickInstall.notes: Requirements guide officially links first-party Word Press plugin; marketplace installation verified. Standalone download/manual server setup separate.
